name: Gravity screening of known/derived Khafre interior chamber envelopes

uncertainty.density_note: 2600 kg/m^3 is a modeling contrast, not a measured density field for every location.
uncertainty.geometry_note: The geometry itself is UNVERIFIED; conventional confidence intervals would be misleading.

interpretation_guard: This uses DERIVED chamber envelope geometry as a screening model. It is not a complete density model of the pyramid or bedrock.
